label: algorithm_implements_method
law: Algorithm realizes some method under assumptions.

label: artifact_affiliated_with
law: Affiliation at the artifact occurrence, not permanent identity.

label: artifact_authored_by
law: Bibliographic contribution only; never implies sole invention.

label: artifact_defines
law: Artifact supplies an explicit definition in a cited edition.

label: artifact_evaluates_on
law: Evaluation protocol and partition must be retained.

label: artifact_extends
law: Adds semantics/operations; does not erase predecessor identity.

label: artifact_introduces_method
law: Requires textual evidence; first-publication priority remains unadjudicated.

label: artifact_manifests_edition
law: Exact downloadable/identified artifact manifests one edition.

label: artifact_maps_to_compiler
law: Research-derived candidate mapping, gated by adjudication.

label: artifact_replicated_by
law: Replication kind and deviations must be explicit.

label: artifact_supersedes_edition
law: Edition relation; earlier historical evidence remains addressable.

label: artifact_transforms_to
law: A documented representational transformation, not equivalence.

label: claim_contradicts
law: Only after question, estimand, population, protocol, and metric alignment.

label: claim_supported_by
law: Support is scoped, defeasible, and never global by default.

label: edition_of_work
law: Edition identity remains distinct from the abstract scholarly work.

label: venue_occurrence_hosts_edition
law: Venue occurrence is dated and does not become the work identity.
